messages:
maria gonzalez: Heads-up — I opened a small RFC-style PR to add a deprecation matrix for old dedicated provisioning fields (tenant_affinity, legacy_scale_policy). Link: https://git/repo/pulls/4823  
kevin li: Saw it, thx. Quick ask: can we include which SDK versions still accept the legacy fields? customers keep hitting 400s.
sam rao: we should also call out the migration CLI. I can paste a tiny snippet to the PR if folks want.
kevin li: please do. Ideally a one-liner: detect -> convert -> dry-run.
mar ia gonzalez: (typo) i mean maria :) adding sample would be great. Also: SLA wording needs a tiny tweak — avoid promising specific p99 numbers for reserved pools, we want ranges.
erin taylor: re: SLA wording, legal wants: "SLA targets are indicative and vary by region and reservation tier" — would that work?
maria gonzalez: yep, that's closer. I'll push that change.
docbot: Automated check: PR description missing cross-links to "Dedicated capacity provisioning" handbook. Recommend adding anchor to /handbook/dedicated/provisioning.md#deprecation.
kevin li: Oh — there are two broken links in the current handbook page. I logged them in the PR comments.
sam rao: Here's the CLI snippet I mentioned — can we include this under a Migration subsection?

```bash
# dry-run convert legacy tenant labels to new format
redwoodctl dedicated migrate-tenant --input tenant.yaml --dry-run
# apply
redwoodctl dedicated migrate-tenant --input tenant.yaml --apply
```

kevin li: Nice. Add a note: this requires SDK >= 0.9.3 or CLI 1.12.0. Otherwise the --apply flag is ignored.
erin taylor: Also include a tiny YAML example for old vs new labels so docs readers can eyeball differences quickly.
maria gonzalez: Good point. I'll add a two-column example and a short script for batch migration.
docbot: Lint check: code block languages detected. OK. Missed: the PR doesn't tag the internal oncall for dedicated docs (docs@team).
maria gonzalez: tagging now — @kevin li @erin taylor can you both review the migration wording? also need a second signoff on SLA phrasing.
kevin li: reviewing today. I think we should add an isolation note: when converting, legacy tenant labels might change placement on reserved pools, causing micro-preemptions during the rollout. call it out as "short disruption window" instead of outage.
sam rao: added a short note: "expected transient request throttling for up to 90s" in the migration steps. hope that's accurate.
erin taylor: Legal accepted the phrasing. Ops wants a blurb about rollback: include the command to revert label changes from backup YAML.
maria gonzalez: I'll add rollback lines and a link to the runbook.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging -> /handbook/dedicated at 1718002000 by maria gonzalez
kevin li: after staging deploy, can someone manually test the tenant conversion flow with a small fake tenant? I can script a smoke test.
sam rao: I can run that in the afternoon. Will report failures in this thread.
maria gonzalez: thanks all. Plan: merge PR after reviews + staging smoke test. I'll also open a tiny follow-up to update SDK snippets in quickstart pages.
kevin li: One last nit: in the autoscale policy section, change "preemption may occur" -> "preemption may occur for low-priority tenants during peak reclaim events". More precise.
erin taylor: agree. small wording tweak approved.
sam rao: smoke test passed locally. no visible throttling beyond 30s for a 3-node reserved pool.
maria gonzalez: awesome — merging once kenkins passes. tagging docs@team for visibility and add a changelog entry under "what's changed". :tada:
